nodes.label: Event Bus (GameEvents)
nodes.rationale: Decouples everything: InputManager -> GameEvents <- GameManager <- UI/Audio/Difficulty. No manager references another except through SaveManager.Data and DifficultyManager read-only values.

nodes.label: Bootstrapper Auto-Creation
nodes.rationale: Managers are auto-created by Bootstrapper so no scene objects are needed; Bootstrapper detects manually placed managers and skips creation.

nodes.label: Main Scene
nodes.rationale: Single scene design: Bootstrap GO, Main Camera, Canvas with MenuScreen, GameplayHUD, GameOverScreen, PauseOverlay.

nodes.label: Phase 2 Color Rules
nodes.rationale: White=Opposite, Blue=Same, Red=Ignore, Green=DoubleOpposite; unlocked by score thresholds 0/20/50/100/150. DifficultyManager.RollColorRule assigns, RuleEngine validates, UI only renders.

nodes.label: Chaos System Flow
nodes.rationale: DifficultyManager.ChaosChance (5% at 150 -> 50% at 300) -> ChaosManager rolls between instructions -> OnChaosStarted/OnChaosEnded -> GameManager applies gameplay warps, FeedbackManager renders visuals. ChaosManager never touches FeedbackManager. 10 chaos types including ScreenRotate, ReverseControls, FakeGameOver, FakeInstructions.

nodes.label: Daily Challenge
nodes.rationale: Deterministic from yyyymmdd seed so everyone gets the same challenge. Five archetypes: Only-rule, No Mistakes, Double Speed, One Life, Gauntlet. Constraints apply through existing authorities reacting to OnChallengeStarted; one reward per day via lastDailyCompletedSeed.

nodes.label: Achievements
nodes.rationale: 14 built-in definitions in AchievementData.All; unlocks persist in PlayerData.unlockedAchievements; OnAchievementUnlocked(id, coinBonus) pays via CurrencyManager and AchievementUI toasts.

nodes.label: Currency (Coins)
nodes.rationale: Coins = run score + maxCombo/5 plus achievement bonuses and daily challenge rewards; OnCoinsChanged(total, delta) drives UI.

nodes.label: Cosmetics
nodes.rationale: Catalog asset in Resources; renderers read CosmeticManager.EquippedFor(category) and listen to OnCosmeticEquipped. Visual only — no gameplay reads cosmetics.

nodes.label: Rewarded Ads
nodes.rationale: IAdProvider -> MockAdProvider (dev) -> real AdMob/Unity Ads adapter later; only AdsManager.OnSingletonAwake changes. Rewards: ContinueRun, DoubleCoins, DailyBonus via OnAdRewardEarned. No interstitials or banners.

nodes.label: Leaderboards
nodes.rationale: ILeaderboardProvider -> MockLeaderboardProvider; swap in Play Games Services at release. Submits high score and longest combo on OnRunEnded; daily challenge board on completed challenges.

nodes.label: Object Pooling
nodes.rationale: ObjectPoolManager Get/Release/Prewarm keyed by prefab; route all effect spawns through it — never Instantiate/Destroy in gameplay. Part of no-per-frame-allocation policy.

nodes.label: Performance Monitoring
nodes.rationale: FPS/frame time/memory/GC overlay, editor and development builds only (#if UNITY_EDITOR || DEVELOPMENT_BUILD), toggled with F3; stripped from release.

nodes.label: SaveManager Persistence
nodes.rationale: SaveManager remains the sole persistence layer; all managers persist through it (settings via SaveManager.Data, lifetime stats, unlocked achievements).

nodes.label: Release Build Checklist
nodes.rationale: IL2CPP + ARM64, R8 minify, portrait lock, sprite atlas, Vorbis music/PCM SFX; targets 60 FPS, <150 MB RAM, <100 MB APK.

nodes.label: Scene-Placed FeedbackManager
nodes.rationale: FeedbackManager is scene-placed because it needs scene refs (camera rig, particles, HUD elements) and subscribes to GameEvents only; chaos logic must not grow into it.

nodes.label: Input Schemes (Swipe + Tap)
nodes.rationale: Swipe or tap depending on scheme toggled on the menu; editor supports arrow keys/WASD, mouse-drag swipe, click zones in Tap mode.

nodes.label: DOTween
nodes.rationale: Required from Checkpoint 2 for tweened feedback and chaos effects like ScreenRotate.
